items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: Oh, Don was it Donal Cooks? Was he a bass player?

ctx.x: Yeah. Silvers. Yeah. That's, that's who it is. That's, that's who was in charge of the session. I don't know.
Silvers. Oh, Don was it Donal Cooks? Was he a bass player?

No, uh, no. He didn't play. He didn't play anything, I don't think. Uh, well he could, but uh, he didn't. You know, he could play, you know, I think he, he played piano. And his wife, uh, she sung. And he was in charge of the session.
